# Class: `SessionFreezeAnnotationCommand`

Undo/redo command for manual freeze annotations.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-session.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_session.py#L143) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QUndoCommand`.

Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_freeze_annotation_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.
